# `@qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-ui`

> Foundation + app UI (Button, Card, Dialog, Tabs, AppShell, …).

Part of **brand-ui**, a source-owned, token-driven React component system.
These packages are **private** and published to GitHub Packages.

## Install

You need a token — GitHub Packages has no anonymous read for private packages.
Add to your project's `.npmrc`:

```ini
@qlik-coe-emea:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=${GITHUB_TOKEN}
```

`GITHUB_TOKEN` must be a **classic** PAT with the `read:packages` scope —
fine-grained PATs do not reliably work with this registry. Then:

```bash
pnpm add @qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-ui
```

## Set up styling (do not skip)

Components are Tailwind v4 classes backed by semantic tokens. Two lines in
your CSS entry, or **everything renders unstyled** — the single most common
mistake:

```css
@import "@qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-tokens/styles.css";
@source "../node_modules/@qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-ui/dist";
```

The `@source` line is required because Tailwind ignores `node_modules`. Add
one per brand-ui package you render. Then wrap your app once:

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-tokens";

<ThemeProvider defaultTheme="qlik-bright">{children}</ThemeProvider>;
```

## This package specifically

- The class-merge helper is at `.../lib/cn` — a pure, server-safe entry point.

## What's in it

355 exported components — including `Accordion`, `AccordionContent`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`, `AdvancedGroup`.

Don't guess the API — ask the CLI:

```bash
pnpm add -D @qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-cli
pnpm exec brand-ui search <query>   # find a component
pnpm exec brand-ui docs <Name>      # its real props, from source
```

## Using an AI coding agent?

Install the CLI above and, for Claude Code, the plugin:

```
/plugin marketplace add Qlik-CoE-EMEA/qlabs-components
/plugin install brand-ui
```

`brand-ui docs <Name>` returns intent, composition, state→token mappings and
anti-patterns — tell your agent to run it instead of guessing a prop. The CLI
also runs as an MCP server (`brand-ui mcp`).
